title: MTConnectStreams
description: MTConnect MTConnectStreams response, v2 JSON, from SysML model v2.1.

name.description: name of the {{block(Device)}}. The value reported for {{property(name,DeviceStream)}} **MUST** be the same as the value defined for the {{property(name,Device)}} attribute of the same {{block(Device)}} in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

uuid.description: uuid of the {{block(Device)}}. The value reported for {{property(uuid,DeviceStream)}} **MUST** be the same as the value defined for the {{property(uuid,Device)}} attribute of the same {{block(Device)}} in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

ComponentStream.title: ComponentStream
ComponentStream.description: organizes the data associated with each {{block(Component)}} entity defined for a {{block(Device)}} in the associated {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

component.description: identifies the {{block(Component)}} type associated with the {{block(ComponentStream)}}. Examples of {{property(component)}} are {{block(Device)}}, {{block(Controller)}}, {{block(Linear)}} and {{block(Loader)}}.

componentId.description: identifier of the {{block(Component)}} as defined by the {{property(id)}} attribute in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

name.description: name of the {{block(Component)}} associated with the {{block(ComponentStream)}}.

nativeName.description: common name of the {{block(Component)}} associated with the {{block(ComponentStream)}}.

uuid.description: uuid of the {{block(Component)}} associated with the {{block(ComponentStream)}}.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: abstract entity that provides telemetry data for a {{block(DataItem)}} at a point in time.

value.description: {{term(observation)}} of the {{block(Observation)}} entity. The default value type for {{property(result)}} is `string`.

compositionId.description: identifier of the {{block(Composition)}} entity defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}} associated with the data reported for the {{block(Observation)}}.

dataItemId.description: unique identifier of the {{block(DataItem)}} associated with this {{block(Observation)}}. {{property(dataItemId)}} **MUST** match the {{property(id)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

name.description: name of the {{block(DataItem)}} associated with this {{block(Observation)}}. {{property(name)}} **MUST** match the {{property(name)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

sequence.description: number representing the sequential position of an occurrence of an {{term(observation)}} in the data buffer of an {{term(agent)}}. {{property(sequence)}} **MUST** have a value represented as an unsigned 64-bit value from 1 to $$ 2^{64}-1 $$.

subType.description: subtype of the {{block(DataItem)}} associated with this {{block(Observation)}}. {{property(subType)}} **MUST** match the {{property(subType)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

timestamp.description: most accurate time available to a piece of equipment that represents the point in time that the data reported was measured.

type.description: type of the {{block(DataItem)}} associated with this {{block(Observation)}}. {{property(type)}} **MUST** match the {{property(type)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

units.description: units of the {{block(DataItem)}} associated with this {{block(Observation)}}. {{property(units)}} **MUST** match the {{property(units)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

allOf.title: Sample
allOf.description: {{block(Observation)}} that is continuously changing or analog data value.

duration.description: time-period over which the data was collected. {{property(duration)}} **MUST** be provided when the {{property(statistic)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} is defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

resetTriggered.description: identifies when a reported value has been reset and what has caused that reset to occur for those {{block(DataItem)}} entities that may be periodically reset to an initial value. {{property(resetTriggered)}} **MUST** only be provided for the specific occurrence of a {{block(DataItem)}} reported in the {{term(MTConnectStreams Response Document)}} when the reset occurred.

sampleRate.description: rate at which successive samples of the value are recorded.

statistic.description: type of statistical calculation defined by the {{property(statistic)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

allOf.title: Event
allOf.description: {{block(Observation)}} that is a discrete piece of information from a piece of equipment.

resetTriggered.description: identifies when a reported value has been reset and what has caused that reset to occur for those {{block(DataItem)}} entities that may be periodically reset to an initial value. {{property(resetTriggered)}} **MUST** only be provided for the specific occurrence of a {{block(DataItem)}} reported in the {{term(MTConnectStreams Response Document)}} when the reset occurred.

allOf.title: Condition
allOf.description: {{block(Observation)}} that provides the {{term(condition)}} of a piece of equipment or a {{term(Component)}}.

nativeCode.description: native code (usually an alpha-numeric value) generated by the controller of a piece of equipment providing a reference identifier for a {{block(Condition)}}. This is the same information an operator or maintenance personnel may see as a reference code designating a specific fault code provided by the piece of equipment.

nativeSeverity.description: severity information to a client software application if the piece of equipment designates a severity level to a fault.

qualifier.description: additional information regarding a {{term(condition state)}} associated with the measured value of a process variable. {{property(qualifier)}} defines whether the {{term(condition state)}} represented indicates a measured value that is above or below an expected value of a process variable.

statistic.description: {{property(statistic)}} provides additional information describing the meaning of the {{block(Condition)}} element. {{property(statistic)}} **MUST** match the {{property(statistic)}} attribute of the {{block(DataItem)}} entity defined in the {{term(MTConnectDevices Response Document)}}.

xs:lang.description: specifies the language of the {{property(result)}} returned for the {{block(Condition)}}. See {{cite(IETF RFC 4646)}} (http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc4646.txt).

state.description: {{term(condition state)}} of the piece of equipment or {{block(Component)}}.

Representation.title: Representation
Representation.description: specifies the format and structure of the {{property(result)}} for an {{block(Observation)}}.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: default {{block(Representation)}} type for all {{block(Observation)}} types where {{property(result)}} of the {{block(Observation)}} types is an MTConnect data type. See {{package(DataTypes)}}.

TimeSeries.title: TimeSeries
TimeSeries.description: {{block(Representation)}} for an {{block(Observation)}} composed of a series of sampled data.

sampleCount.description: number of values given for the {{block(Observation)}}.

Discrete.title: Discrete
Discrete.description: **DEPRECATED** {{block(Representation)}} for an {{block(Observation)}} where each discrete occurrence of the data may have the same value as the previous occurrence of the data.

DataSet.title: DataSet
DataSet.description: {{block(Representation)}} for an {{block(Observation)}} composed of value(s) represented as a set of {{termplural(key-value pair)}}.

Entry.title: Entry
Entry.description: {{term(key-value pair)}} published as part of a {{block(DataSet)}}.

value.description: value of the {{block(Entry)}}.

Table.title: Table
Table.description: {{block(Representation)}} for an {{block(Observation)}} composed of two-dimensional sets of {{termplural(key-value pair)}} where the {{block(Entry)}} represents rows containing sets of {{termplural(key-value pair)}} given by {{block(Cell)}} entities.

count.description: number of {{termplural(key-value pair)}} represented as {{block(Entry)}} entities.

TableEntry.title: TableEntry
TableEntry.description: {{term(key-value pair)}} published as part of a {{block(Table)}}. > Note: In the {{term(XML)}} representation, {{block(TableEntry)}} **MUST** appear as {{block(Entry)}}.

Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description: {{term(key-value pair)}} published as part of a {{block(TableEntry)}}.

value.description: value of the {{block(Cell)}}.
